# /etc/systemd/system/nexusd.service
[Unit]
Description=Nexus server manager daemon
Documentation=https://github.com/mauktik/nexus
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
# READY=1 is sent once every listener is open (sd_notify(3)).
Type=notify
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/nexusd serve --config /etc/nexus/nexusd.yaml
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
Restart=on-failure

# /var/lib/nexus: state.db, tokens.json, tls/ and ops/<id>/.
StateDirectory=nexus
StateDirectoryMode=0700
# /var/log/nexus: audit.jsonl and its rotations.
LogsDirectory=nexus
LogsDirectoryMode=0700

# Hardening. Privileged work (apt, scripts, container updates) runs in
# nexus-op-* transient units started through systemd-run, outside this
# sandbox. Every directive removed later is recorded with its reason in
# docs/security.md (A-23).
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
# Read-only, not inaccessible: scripts and Compose files can live in home
# directories, and the integrity checks must read them.
ProtectHome=read-only
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
# AF_NETLINK: net.Interfaces reads the interface addresses for the
# generated certificate's SANs over netlink.
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
Exit 0
